steps.js: const { S, scene } = app, G = S.G, m = scene.children.find((o) => o.isMesh && o.geometry.getAttribute('color')), col = m.geometry.getAttribute('color'); const fb = new Float32Array(G.nF); for (let e = 0; e < G.nE; e++) { fb[G.ea[e]] = Math.max(fb[G.ea[e]], G.bar[e]); fb[G.eb[e]] = Math.max(fb[G.eb[e]], G.bar[e]); } const lo = [0.62, 0.65, 0.70], hi = [0.85, 0.05, 0.05]; for (let f = 0; f < G.nF; f++) { const t = Math.min(1, fb[f] / 8); for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) col.array[9*f+3*c+k] = lo[k] + (hi[k] - lo[k]) * t; } col.needsUpdate = true; app.render()
